parameters.query:
select camp.id            as campaign_id,
       camp.external_id   as campaign_external_id,
       camp.name          as campaign_name,
       camp.status        as campaign_status,
       cs.api_key         as external_api_key
from public.campaigns camp
join public.clients c on c.id = camp.client_id
join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.id and cs.enabled
join public.sequencers        s  on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
where c.status = 'Active'
  and coalesce(cs.api_key, '') <> ''
  and camp.status in ('active', 'launching', 'stopped', 'completed')
order by c.name, camp.name;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO campaign_daily_stats (campaign_id, report_date, sent_count, reply_count, bounce_count, unique_open_count, positive_replies_count, inboxes_active) VALUES ('{{ $json.campaign_id }}', '{{ $json.report_date }}', {{ $json.sent_count }}, {{ $json.reply_count }}, {{ $json.bounce_count }}, {{ $json.unique_open_count }}, {{ $json.positive_replies_count }}, {{ $json.inboxes_active }}) ON CONFLICT (campaign_id, report_date) DO UPDATE SET   sent_count             = EXCLUDED.sent_count,   reply_count            = EXCLUDED.reply_count,   bounce_count           = EXCLUDED.bounce_count,   unique_open_count      = EXCLUDED.unique_open_count,   positive_replies_count = EXCLUDED.positive_replies_count,   inboxes_active         = EXCLUDED.inboxes_active RETURNING campaign_id, report_date, sent_count, reply_count
